name: ffuf
description: ffuf (Fuzz Faster U Fool) is a fast web fuzzer written in Go. It can be used for directory and file enumeration, virtual host discovery, and more.

inputs.label: Target URL (-u):
inputs.help: The target URL to fuzz. Use 'FUZZ' to specify the position for the wordlist.

inputs.label: Wordlist File (-w):
inputs.help: Path to the wordlist file. Can use multiple comma-separated wordlists (e.g., '/path1/wordlist1.txt:PATH1,/path2/wordlist2.txt:PATH2').

inputs.label: Upload Wordlist File:
inputs.help: Upload a wordlist file to use for fuzzing.

inputs.label: Request File Path (-request):
inputs.help: Load HTTP request from a text file. FUZZ keyword can be used in the file.

inputs.label: Upload Request File:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing a raw HTTP request.

inputs.label: Enable Recursion (-recursion)
inputs.help: Recursively fuzz found directories.

inputs.label: Recursion Depth (-recursion-depth):
inputs.help: Maximum recursion depth.

inputs.label: Recursion Wordlist (-recursion-wordlist):
inputs.help: Wordlist to use for recursive fuzzing. If not specified, uses the main wordlist.

inputs.label: Filter by Status Code (-fc):
inputs.help: Filter out results by status code. Use comma-separated values. Can use ranges (e.g., '200-299').

inputs.label: Filter by Size (-fs):
inputs.help: Filter out results by response size. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Filter by Word Count (-fw):
inputs.help: Filter out results by word count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Filter by Line Count (-fl):
inputs.help: Filter out results by line count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Filter by Character Count (-fx):
inputs.help: Filter out results by character count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Match by Status Code (-mc):
inputs.help: Match results by status code. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Match by Size (-ms):
inputs.help: Match results by response size. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Match by Word Count (-mw):
inputs.help: Match results by word count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Match by Line Count (-ml):
inputs.help: Match results by line count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: Match by Character Count (-mx):
inputs.help: Match results by character count. Use comma-separated values.

inputs.label: HTTP Cookie (-cookie):
inputs.help: HTTP Cookie header.

inputs.label: POST Data (-d):
inputs.help: POST data string.

inputs.label: HTTP Headers (-H):
inputs.help: Extra HTTP headers separated by newline.

inputs.label: Proxy (-proxy):
inputs.help: Use a proxy to connect to the target URL.

inputs.label: Threads (-t):
inputs.help: Number of concurrent threads (default is 40).

inputs.label: Timeout (-timeout):
inputs.help: HTTP request timeout in seconds.

inputs.label: Follow Redirects (-followredirects)
inputs.help: Follow HTTP redirects.

inputs.label: Verbose (-v)
inputs.help: Show verbose output.

inputs.label: Output File (-o):
inputs.help: Output file name.

inputs.label: Output Format (-of):
inputs.help: Output file format.

inputs.label: Max Time (-maxtime):
inputs.help: Maximum amount of time to run the scan in seconds.

inputs.label: Request Rate (-rate):
inputs.help: Limit the number of requests per second.

inputs.label: Delay (-delay):
inputs.help: Delay between requests (e.g., '1s', '500ms').

inputs.label: Host Header (-H 'Host: ...'):
inputs.help: Specify a custom Host header for virtual host fuzzing.

inputs.label: Custom Wordlist Input:
inputs.help: Enter a custom wordlist directly into the text box. The file will be created and uploaded automatically.
